text:
Ana M.: Quick sync — we need to lock the commit phasing for the upcoming private offers across AWS/GCX and the SI onboarding windows.
Liam K.: timeline idea: 3 tranches over 12 months (pilot -> scale -> steady-state). keeps renewals aligned to quarter boundaries.
Rachel S.: +1 on tranches. question: what constraints do our SI partners have for onboarding ramp? some need 6-8 weeks for integration + training.
Ana M.: exact. proposal: pilot tranche (month 0-3) reserved for 3 certified SIs, scale tranche (months 4-9) expands to all SIs with joint enablement, steady-state (months 10-12) opens broader marketplace discounts.
Jon P.: For the HW partner announcement, they want a single joint press window. If we stagger marketplace private offers, we should avoid diluting that PR moment. maybe soft-launch partners first, big announce at scale tranche.
Liam K.: agreed. also need to map SKU/crediting so SI-delivered deals don't double-credit. rough mapping:
```
SKU,CommitBucket,CreditType
INF-DED-1,Pilot,SI-Referral-Credit
INF-DED-2,Scale,Channel-Credit
INF-DED-3,Open,Marketplace-Discount
```
Rachel S.: good. ops question: how are we gating private-offer eligibility? by commit size + SI certification tag?
Ana M.: gating rule: commits >= $250k qualify for pilot private SKU + required SI certified level >= silver. scale tranche lowers commit floor to $100k and auto-enrolls certified partners.
Jon P.: Legal flagged term alignment for renewals — need 60-day notice for rate/discount changes included in PO. add to enablement checklist.
Liam K.: pricing recommendation: start with 20% off list for pilot, step to 12% for scale, 8% for steady-state. we can tie to usage velocity credits during first 6 months.
Rachel S.: action items: 1) Ana to confirm SI roster for pilot (deadline Tue). 2) Liam to publish SKU mapping to marketplace (end of week). 3) Jon to add renewal clause to PO template and confirm with legal (3 business days).
Ana M.: I'll ping partner enablement and cc the HW partner PM. FYI @hw-partner-bot will post the joint PR calendar when we confirm dates.
hw-partner-bot: automated: scheduled PR window placeholder created: 2026-05-18 to 2026-05-22. react with :white_check_mark: to confirm.
Jon P.: noted. last question — any objections to aligning the pilot customer cohort with our Dedicated customers to prove latency/SLAs?
Rachel S.: love that. SIs appreciate concrete performance benchmarks in sales collateral.
Liam K.: no objections. I'll draft a short one-pager for marketplace listing that calls out commit tiers, SI benefits, and HW bundle notes.
Ana M.: thanks team. keeping this short — if no objections by EOD Friday we'll lock the tranche dates and inform marketing/PR. :thumbsup:
